description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008, Order Under Sub Section (4) of Section (3)
categorisation: This gazette content is an Order made under the Strategic Development Projects Act, No. 14 of 2008. It outlines specific regulatory frameworks, tax exemptions (Corporate Income Tax, VAT), and compliance requirements for enterprises within a designated development zone. The core content involves the application and modification of existing laws and the creation of a new regulatory framework for a specific project, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters.
